_doc: MAP V2 ROADMAP R6(a) SIGNAL-STRENGTH (research/open_questions.md: 'ladder position of every root, gate passed/date/next gate, from research/ bookkeeping made machine-readable'). Hand-compiled 2026-07-30 by reading research/experiments.md and research/open_questions.md for explicit ROOT VALIDATION LADDER gate-status language (CLAUDE.md defines gates 1-5: DATA/SIGNAL/LOGIC/SIZING/EXECUTION). Every entry carries a source_ref pointing at the file/line or session date the status came from, so a human or a future session can re-verify rather than trust this file blindly — same discipline as entity_map.json's provenance notes. This is a SNAPSHOT, not a live feed: it reflects the ladder position as of last_update_date per root and goes stale as new gate runs land; a future session should re-run the compilation (or extend it) periodically, not treat it as self-updating. RAW overlays (status raw_only, current_gate 0) make no predictive claim by design — the ladder does not apply to them, they are not 'behind' signal roots that failed a gate. Status values: raw_only, gate1_pending, gate1_pass, gate1_fail, gate2_pending, gate2_pass, gate2_fail, gate3_pass, gate4_pass, gate5_pass, killed.

roots.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders (Legacy) positioning extremes
roots.note: Gate 1 DATA passed 2026-07-05 (0 rejections across 156-week backfill, 7 symbols). Gate-2 screen killed GLD/CORN/SPY/QQQ/TLT outright and, after a Newey-West HAC correction, also killed SLV; only USO survives as a quantified-but-unpromoted carry (p=0.0355, fails the multi-comparison Bonferroni bar) — explicitly not promoted to LOGIC gate 3.

roots.name: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures (leveraged-money positioning)
roots.note: GATE 1 stays PASSED (v1.0.552, unaffected). GATE 2 KILLED (v1.0.587): cftc_tff_gate2_test.py pre-registered 'leveraged-money net-positioning extremes mean-revert' (COT-index style 0-100 trailing-156-week bucket, extreme_high/low >=80/<=20) tested on 7 liquid ETF<->TFF-futures pairs (SPY/QQQ/TLT/IEF/SHY/UUP/FXE) x 2 horizons (20d/60d) x 2 buckets = 28 comparisons, Newey-West HAC-corrected from the start (not iterated to, unlike the Legacy-COT precedent). Applying a Bonferroni bar across the 28 comparisons (alpha/28=0.0018) leaves only 3 survivors, and they contradict a single mean-reversion story: TLT extreme_high +3.075% and extreme_low -6.503% at 20d (both p<0.0013, the low bucket ~1e-18) are the WRONG SIGN for mean-reversion (a real, strong, but MOMENTUM/continuation pattern instead); only UUP extreme_high -1.107% (p=0.0013) points the predicted direction. The general 'leveraged-money extremes mean-revert across financial futures' hypothesis, AS STATED, is REJECTED — where a Bonferroni-surviving effect exists it is asset-specific and directionally inconsistent, not the one coherent mechanism the hypothesis proposed. The TLT momentum finding is filed as its own distinct, un-pre-registered candidate (needs a disjoint out-of-sample window before any trust, same discipline as the 2026-08-03 OCC reversal candidate) rather than promoted here. Dealer-side positioning (cftcTff.ts's own 'informed side' docstring hypothesis) remains untested, a separate un-pre-registered hypothesis for a future session. RAW /api/data/tff display + archive are unaffected (raw overlay, no predictive claim) and keep running.

roots.name: FINRA daily short-volume (4-facility CNMS reconstruction)
roots.note: GATE 1 PASSED 2026-07-05 (100.000% sum-of-parts identity across 12,240 symbols vs FINRA's own 4 independent per-facility files). GATE 2 FIRST-PASS RUN 2026-08-06 (scripts/finra_shortvol_gate2.ts): FAIL against the pre-registered composite bar — day-clustered HIGH_SHORT/NEUTRAL/LOW_SHORT buckets, 16 weekly Wednesdays 2026-01-07..2026-04-22. The +20d HIGH-LOW spread alone clears significance (t=2.279 > crit=2.131, df=15) but the required monotonic ordering fails: NEUTRAL underperforms LOW_SHORT at both horizons (a U-shape, not a gradient) — per Reasoning Standard #4 the composite bar governs, not the significant piece alone. NOT marked killed: a single first attempt with a specific, informative failure mode, not a clean directional refutation like the other killed roots each needed a second confirming test for. Follow-up hypothesis (retest HIGH_SHORT vs a full-population baseline, regime-split) filed in open_questions.md.

roots.name: JODI World oil closing-stock levels
roots.note: GATE 1 stays PASSED (unaffected): the 2026-07-07 first look compared the wrong JODI product (US|CRUDEOIL alone) against EIA commercial+SPR; US|TOTCRUDE reconciles cleanly (-1.2% full-history level gap, MoM delta correlation 0.735) via scripts/jodi_eia_reconcile.py. GATE 2 KILLED same day: scripts/jodi_gate2_test.py pre-registered that an aggregate month-over-month BUILD in non-OECD crude-exporter TOTCRUDE stocks (trailing-36mo z-scored composite across the 4 countries with complete, current, producer-side coverage — Saudi Arabia/Nigeria/Algeria/Brunei; UAE/India both failed a data-quality bar — UAE stopped reporting TOTCRUDE after 2018-12, India's TOTCRUDE carries many literal-zero months — and were excluded, stated honestly rather than forced) predicts a NEGATIVE forward return in BNO/USO over 20d/60d, 60-day publish-lag no-lookahead entry. RESULT: all 4 comparisons (2 assets x 2 horizons) point the pre-registered direction (build mean < draw mean) but NONE clear even an uncorrected 0.05 bar, let alone the pre-stated Bonferroni bar of 0.0125 — BNO 20d t=-1.536/p=0.1245, BNO 60d t=-0.494/p=0.6214, USO 20d t=-1.481/p=0.1385, USO 60d t=-0.334/p=0.7381. Consistent with this session's own stated prior (LOW-MODERATE, ~25-30%): OPEC+ producer stock trends are already tracked near-real-time by professional oil desks (tanker-tracking, satellite, OPEC's own monthly reports) — JODI's ~2-month-lagged release is stale by the time it publishes, not an edge. KILLED at gate 2 as pre-registered (SIGNAL layer, never traded/sold). The gate-1 archive/RAW value stands unaffected — a real, EIA-consistent free data source (EDGE DOCTRINE #1), just not a tradeable signal on this construction.

Extends a prior single-anecdote check (one US48 hour, 1.1% one-time revision) into a systematic instrument; a single 9-minute-separated run, not a multi-day battery — a future session could widen the separation window or repeat across several days for additional confidence, but the measured magnitude is already far below any decision-relevant threshold for a RAW display with no predictive claim yet. roots.name: OCC customer vs market-maker options volume (put/call by ticker)
roots.note: GATE 1 stays PASSED (v1.0.580, unaffected). GATE 2 KILLED (v1.0.585): scripts/occ_volume_gate2.ts pre-registered a customer-only call/put skew (ISEE-successor definition, honesty caveat stated up front: OCC's feed has no buy/sell or open/close direction, a cruder proxy than true ISEE) tested on 16 weekly sample days (2026-01-07..04-22) x fixed 40-name CALL/PUT/NEUTRAL buckets (FLOOR=8000 customer contracts, calibrated on volume only, never on outcome) x Yahoo forward returns at +5d/+20d. PRE-STATED PASS BAR (CALL>NEUTRAL>PUT on both horizons AND |t20|>2) FAILED: the ordering came back REVERSED — PUT_SKEW outperformed CALL_SKEW at both horizons (+5d: -0.12% vs -0.72%; +20d: +1.71% vs -1.16%, spread -2.87%, Welch t=-2.30 naive-pooled). The tested hypothesis (customer call-heavy skew = bullish signal) is REJECTED in its stated direction, not merely inconclusive. The reversed pattern is NOT promoted to a new signal here — it is one pre-registered test, not fished, but the t-stat is naive-pooled (n~610-630 treated as i.i.d. when it is really ~16 independent day-clusters with within-day cross-sectional correlation and ticker overlap across weeks), so it materially overstates significance; filed as an unconfirmed candidate in open_questions.md needing clustered SEs + true out-of-sample replication before any trust, not as a validated reversal. RAW /api/data/occ-volume display + archive are unaffected (raw overlays carry no predictive claim) and keep running.
